ScriptBlockText=<<<# SOC-002 PHASE 5 - CONTROLLED BENIGN TEST
# Marker: SOC002-PHASE5-ENCODED-POWERSHELL
# Purpose: harmless observable output only. No persistence, no network, no modification.
$marker = 'SOC002-PHASE5-ENCODED-POWERSHELL'
Write-Output $marker
Write-Output ('HOST=' + $env:COMPUTERNAME)
Write-Output ('USER=' + [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name)
Write-Output ('START_UTC=' + (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ'))
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
Write-Output ('END_UTC=' + (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ'))
Write-Output 'BENIGN_CONTROLLED_TEST_COMPLETE'
>>>

ScriptBlockText=<<<$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
$marker = 'SOC002-PHASE5-ENCODED-POWERSHELL'
$b64 = ''
"=== SOC-002 PHASE5 TASK2 CONTROLLED ENCODED POWERSHELL ==="
"MARKER          = $marker"
"OPERATOR_HOST   = $env:COMPUTERNAME"
"OPERATOR_ACCT   = $([System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name)"
"PRE_LOCAL       = $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff')"
"PRE_UTC         = $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ'))"
"PAYLOAD_B64_LEN = $($b64.Length)"
"CHILD_CMD       = powershell.exe -NoProfile -EncodedCommand $b64"
"--- executing (SINGLE run) ---"
$sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
$out = & powershell.exe -NoProfile -EncodedCommand $b64 2>&1
$sw.Stop()
"CHILD_RC        = $LASTEXITCODE"
"CHILD_DUR_MS    = $($sw.ElapsedMilliseconds)"
"POST_UTC        = $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ'))"
"--- child stdout ---"
$out | ForEach-Object { "$_" }
"--- end child stdout ---"
>>>
